title: Tn5 Library Prep for Deep Sequencing of CRISPR/Cas9 Edited Cells
author: Eric Danner
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7k2hkye
materials: Make TAPS buffer 5X TAPS-DMF: 50mM TAPS-NaOH @pH8.5, 25 mM MgCl2, 50% DMF -DMF- Sigma = D4551-250ML TAPS- Sigma = T5130-25G Mw- 243.2 MgCl2 - mw 95.22 DMF is unstable so make 10x and then dilute 1:1 on day of use. For 50ml (100mM TAPS, 50mM MgCl2 pH 8.5) 1.22g TAPS + 0.24g MgCl2. Raise to 40 ml. Titrate to pH8.5 w/ NaOH. Raise to 50ml. If it smells fishy discard. I have used it for 2 weeks without any issue after mixing.

Software for analysis https://github.com/editasmedicine/uditas https://github.com/ericdanner/uditas-replace Required files: for running uditas: Bowtie Index: One may compile your own bowtie2 index. But if your using only human or mouse then you can download the pre compiled and save a few hours. Download the .X.2bt files for your respective genome: http://bowtie-bio.sourceforge.net/bowtie2/index.shtml hg38.1.bt2, hg38.2.bt2, etc (Make sure they are renamed to hg38.X.bt2 etc) Set enviornmental variable: bash command: export BOWTIE2_INDEXES=/file location 2Bit genomes: Download hg38.2bit https://hgdownload.cse.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/hg38/bigZips/hg38.2bit Set environmental variable: bash command: export GENOMES_2BIT=/file location

steps.title: Prepare Adapter Oligos
steps.instruction: Resuspend i5-UMI-TMI and Tn5A-bottom primers at 100uM in 10mM Tris-Hcl pH8 and 0.5mM EDTA.

substeps.instruction: Take 50ul of each primer.
Hybridize for 12 hours, cooling from 95°C to cold at a rate of ~8min/1°C.

steps.title: Complex Oligos with Tn5
steps.instruction: Combine Tn5 (1.85mg/ml in 2x Tn5 dialysis buffer) with annealed primers at room temperature (23°C) on a shaker at 230rpm for 60 minutes.

substeps.instruction: For a 100ul reaction: mix 85.7ul Tn5 and 14.3ul primer.
For a 116.6ul reaction (scaled): mix 100ul Tn5 and 16.8ul primer.
For a 58.3ul reaction: mix 50ul Tn5 and 8.4ul primer.

steps.title: Clean and Prepare gDNA
steps.instruction: Clean genomic DNA (gDNA) to remove inhibitors and RNA before tagmentation.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Remove RNA by adding 1ug/ul of 10mg/ml RNase to 100ul DNA in TE buffer; digest for 10 min at 37°C on a shaker.
Wash twice with 1:1 SPRI beads to remove RNase and contaminants.
Resuspend in Tris-Cl (or 0.1mM EDTA); avoid high EDTA concentrations as they inhibit Tn5.
Measure gDNA concentration using Qubit (Nanodrop is only accurate if RNase was used and 260/280 is 1.8).

steps.title: Tagment gDNA
steps.instruction: Perform tagmentation of gDNA using the assembled transposome.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 20µL reaction containing: 4µL Nuclease free water, 4µL 5x TAPS-DMF, 10µL Genomic DNA (10 ng/µL), and 2µL Assembled transposome.

steps.title: Remove Tn5 Protein
steps.instruction: Inhibit or remove the Tn5 protein from the tagmented DNA using one of three methods.

substeps.instruction: Method 1 (for gel/bioanalyzer only): Add 10ug (0.5ul of 20ug/ul) Proteinase K and incubate 10 minutes at 55°C.
Method 2 (Zymo columns): Add 100ul DNA binding buffer, load on Zymo DNA conc column (not MN columns), wash 2x with 200ul wash buffer, and elute.

Method 3 (SPRI beads - Recommended): Quench 25ul reaction with 5ul 0.2% SDS and incubate at 55°C for 7 min. Increase volume to 100ul with water. Add 90ul SPRI beads (1:0.9 ratio). Elute in 22ul 10mM Tris-Hcl (pH8).

steps.title: Verify Tagmentation
steps.instruction: Confirm tagmentation success via Bioanalyzer or functional PCR.

substeps.instruction: Bioanalyzer: Use DS DNA High Sensitivity chip; look for a peak around 2-3kb (approx. 2ul Tn5 per 50ng gDNA).
Functional PCR: Split 50ng SPRI-cleaned tagmented gDNA into 2-3 volumes. Perform PCR with: 1) i5 primer only (background control), 2) i5 + primer1, and 3) i5 + primer2.

steps.title: PCR 1: Target Region Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the target region using gene-specific primers and i5 primers.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction (25ul or 50ul) with: 5X PrimeSTAR Buffer, TMAC (0.5M), 10mM dNTPs, Gene Primer (10uM), i5 Primer (10uM), OneTaq DNA Polymerase, and Template DNA.
Set annealing temperature (Ta): If Tm > 55°C, set Ta to 60°C; if Tm ≤ 55°C, set Ta to 55°C.
Thermal cycling: 98°C 30s; 12x (98°C 10s, 60°C/55°C 15s, 68°C 60s); Final extension 72°C 3min; Hold 10°C.
Clean up using Ampure XP SPRI beads (1:1 vol), eluting in 25ul nuclease-free water or TE. (Optional: use 0.5x beads first to remove >1kb bands).

steps.title: PCR 2: Nested PCR
steps.instruction: Perform nested PCR to amplify the desired sequence using a gene-specific primer (GSP) containing an i7 adapter sequence.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 50ul reaction: 10ul 5X PrimeSTAR Buffer, 4ul 10mM dNTPs, 3ul TMAC (0.5M), 1ul GSP primer (10uM), 0.5ul i5 Primer (10uM), 1ul OneTaq DNA Polymerase, 25ul Round 1 product, and 5.5ul Nuclease-free water.
Thermal cycling: 98°C 30s; 12x (98°C 10s, 60°C 15s, 68°C 60s); Hold 10°C.
Clean up with Ampure 1:0.9 SPRI beads and elute in 25ul 10mM Tris, 0.1mM EDTA.

steps.title: PCR 3: i7 Indexing
steps.instruction: Add the i7 indexing sequence via PCR.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 50ul reaction: 10ul 5X PrimeSTAR Buffer, 4ul 10mM dNTPs, 2ul i7 primer (10uM), 1ul i5 Primer (10uM), 1ul OneTaq DNA Polymerase, 25ul Round 2 product, and 7ul Nuclease-free water.
Thermal cycling: 98°C 30s; 10-12x (98°C 10s, 65°C/68°C 15s, 68°C 60s); Hold 10°C.
Clean up with Ampure 1:1 SPRI beads.

steps.title: Pool and Concentrate Samples
steps.instruction: Pool equimolar amounts of cleaned amplicons for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Run samples and i5 control on a gel; cut out the desired size (e.g., for 200bp genomic read, cut 346bp amplicon).
Quantify using Kappa Quantification kit (qPCR) or calculate molar amount via Qubit and Bioanalyzer size.
Pool equimolar amounts into a 1mL tube.
Clean and concentrate pool using 0.9x Agencourt Ampure XP SPRI beads; elute in 35µL 1x low TE.

steps.title: Sequencing and Analysis
steps.instruction: Prepare the library for sequencing and process the resulting data.

substeps.instruction: Dilute sample to 1nM (e.g., 10ng of 500bp DNA requires 32x dilution).
Set sequencing parameters: 18 indexing cycles. Read 1 (141bp), Index 1 (i7, 8bp), Index 2 (i5+UMI, 18bp), Read 2 (151bp).
Analyze BCL files with Illumina Sequence Analysis Viewer.
Convert BCL to Fastq using bcl2fastq with the mask: --use-bases-mask=Y151,I8,I18,Y141.
